It is a name that resonates with a sense of power, authority, and godliness. The name is used not only to address the divine deity but also to honor and bestow respect upon respected elders and authorities.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Eshwar holds immense spiritual significance as it refers to the supreme deity, Ishvara. This name reminds us of the divine presence that is omnipresent and omnipotent, guiding and protecting us through our lives. Eshwar is a name that inspires devotion, surrender, and a deep connection to the divine. It is a reminder of the belief that ultimately, all power and control lies with the divine, as we are but a small part of the vast cosmic order.
